# Landing Page — Flatfile Style (Fictional Brand)

## 1. Architecture & Strict Rules

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- Keep all styling strictly inside `style.css`. Forbid `style="..."` attributes in HTML.
- Target all design properties, layout rules, and states via class/ID selectors only.
- Keep HTML clean, semantic, and styling-agnostic so the look can change by editing CSS alone.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Store all visual tokens in `:root` (and theme classes) using CSS variables. Define at minimum:
- Colors: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.
- Theme-specific Flatfile tokens: `--color-midnight-ink: #090b2b`, `--color-obsidian: #151515`, `--color-graphite: #1b1b1e`, `--color-charcoal: #262626`, `--color-steel: #808080`, `--color-silver: #aaaaaa`, `--color-fog: #d7d7d7`, `--color-mist: #e5e7eb`, `--color-parchment: #e5ebd3`, `--color-linen: #f8f8f8`, `--color-paper: #fefefe`, `--color-slate-link: #8c8c8c`.
- Contrast pairing: light backgrounds pair with dark text; dark backgrounds pair with light text — enforce for every theme.
- Light mode background must not be pure white; use the Parchment canvas `#e5ebd3` in the hero and `#fefefe` where a near-white is needed.
- Border radius & shadows: `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 12px`, `--radius-lg: 99px`, `--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(9,11,43,0.04)`, `--shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(9,11,43,0.08)`.
- Spacing & transitions: `--spacing-gap: 16px`, `--transition-fast: 150ms ease`, `--transition-normal: 250ms ease`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)`.
- Elevation/stacking: `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 200`, `--z-toast: 300`.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Provide dark mode color tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class selector; background and text variables must switch seamlessly without HTML restructuring.
- Persist user theme choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; include a visible toggle control with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layouts with Flexbox (`display: flex`).
- Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless an explicitly justified exception exists.
- All layouts must be mobile-responsive out of the box (rows collapse to columns on small viewports); prevent horizontal scrolling.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply` directives) unless another framework is requested. All utility classes must map back to CSS variables or reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Use Google Fonts for text and icons. Include `<link>`/`@import` tags and bind fonts to `--font-base`.
- Text: substitute Flatfile Diatype with Inter (weights 400–500) and Source Serif 4 with the Google Font Source Serif 4; use Space Grotesk as the Sharp Grotesk substitute. Bind `--font-flatfile-diatype`, `--font-source-serif-4`, `--font-sharp-grotesk`.
- Icons: use Google Material Symbols/Icons only. Forbid raw inline SVGs or local icon files.

## 2. Component Design Specifications

**2.1 Button Component**
- Default: flex layout (`display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.5rem`), min touch target 44x44px.
- Hover: visual shift (brightness/shadow), `cursor: pointer`.
- Focus: distinct focus ring via CSS variables.
- Active/Pressed: `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- Loading: disables interactions, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner or animated Google Icon without distorting dimensions.
- Disabled: `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- Success/Error: temporary feedback styles via `--text-success`/`--text-error`.
- Primary CTA: filled `#151515` pill, 99px radius, white text, Inter 16px weight 500, padding 12px 24px.
- Secondary CTA: filled `#e5ebd3` pill, 99px radius, `#090b2b` text weight 500, 16px, padding 12px 24px (hero zone only).

**2.2 Card Component**
- Default: flexible flexbox layout, subtle borders and elevation via `--bg-secondary` and CSS variables.
- Hover: elevation/shadow shift or `transform: translateY(-2px)`.
- Focus-within: highlight card borders when a child link/button receives focus.
- Loading (Skeleton): shimmer animation in CSS, no layout jumps.
- Empty State: structured fallback with a Google Icon and clear guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements**
- States: Empty, Focused (outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border/icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon), Disabled, Read-only.
- Structure: flex container wrapping label, input field, and dedicated error feedback container.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements**
- States: Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing (all animated via CSS transitions).
- UX: centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via `Esc` or overlay clicks.

## 3. Core UX & Micro-Interaction Rules

- Responsive by default: fluid sizing and breakpoints without horizontal overflow.
- Smooth animations: CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast in both Light and Dark modes; never rely solely on color for state; semantic HTML5 elements; correct ARIA roles/labels; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback.
- Mandatory visual feedback for every click, hover, or submission.
- Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 4. Deliverables

- File structure: separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference.
- Naming convention: enforce one consistent convention (BEM or fixed utility set) across the entire deliverable; never mix.
- No unrequested placeholders: prohibit lorem-ipsum-only submissions where real copy/labels were supplied; placeholders allowed only where content was genuinely unspecified.

## Page Sections (in order)

1. **Sticky Top Nav Bar** — floating white pill bar, 99px radius, centered with margin, thin `#e5e7eb` border. Contains logo, ghost nav links (Graphite 16px weight 400, hover to Midnight Ink), divider, "Log in" text link, and dark CTA pill. Theme toggle included.
2. **Hero** — full-bleed Parchment (`#e5ebd3`) wash. Centered headline stack: H1 in Inter 60px weight 400, letter-spacing -1.92px, Midnight Ink. Optional subtext in Slate Link 18px weight 400. Optional centered dark CTA below. Floating white product cards (12px radius, `#e5e7eb` border, subtle shadow) anchor the bottom, showing file rows with colored type icons and extension tags (.xlsx, .ndtx, .json).
3. **Features** — 3 cards on white. Linen (`#f8f8f8`) surface, 12px radius, `#e5e7eb` border, 24–32px padding. Each: chromatic icon, title (Inter 16–22px weight 500 Graphite), body copy (Inter 14–16px Graphite). Hover: `translateY(-2px)`.
4. **How It Works** — 3 steps presented via a dark Obsidian (`#151515`) pill tab bar, 99px radius, padding 8px, white labels 14–16px weight 400 separated by `#262626` hairline dividers; active step weight 500. Supporting copy below in centered single-column stack. 88px section padding.
5. **Testimonials** — single full-width Linen card, 12px radius, `#e5e7eb` border, 32px padding. Top row: author name + role (Graphite 16px) left, customer logos right. Center: quote in Source Serif 4 38px weight 400, Graphite, letter-spacing -1.14px, italic. Bottom: two metric stats (e.g. "25%") in Graphite 22px with caption labels in Silver 12px, plus 40px circular arrow buttons with `#e5e7eb` border on the far right.
6. **Pricing** — 3 tiers on white. Cards: Linen surface, 12px radius, `#e5e7eb` border, 24–32px padding. Tier name, price (Inter 38px weight 400, -1.14px tracking, Midnight Ink), feature list, CTA pill. Middle tier may use a subtle highlight via surface shift (not shadow).
7. **FAQ** — accordion-style items on white. Each: question in Graphite 16–22px weight 500, answer in Graphite 14–16px. Hairline `#e5e7eb` dividers between items. Expand/collapse animated via CSS transitions.
8. **Final CTA** — centered section, 88px top padding. H1 in Inter 60px weight 400, -1.92px tracking, Midnight Ink. Subtext in Slate Link 18px. Centered dark CTA pill below.
9. **Footer** — Obsidian (`#151515`) band. Link list items: flat text, no underline, Slate Link 14–16px, hover to Midnight Ink (inverted to white on dark). Secondary links grouped. Thin `#262626` dividers.

## Style Constraints (Do/Don't)

- Do: use `#151515` filled pills at 99px radius for all primary CTAs — never rectangular buttons.
- Do: set every display heading at 60px in Inter weight 400 with -1.92px tracking; never bolder than 500 for display voice.
- Do: use `#e5e7eb` for all structural dividers and table rules.
- Do: reserve Source Serif 4 exclusively for customer-quote hero text inside testimonial cards.
- Do: layer canvas as Parchment → Paper → Linen for depth instead of adding shadows.
- Do: use 88px section padding above every new page section.
- Do: center page content at max-width 1200px; never edge-to-edge inside content zones.
- Don't: introduce a secondary chromatic brand color — Midnight Ink is the only one.
- Don't: use box-shadows to separate cards; shift surface color one step instead (except the two specified elevation shadows).
- Don't: set body text in anything other than Graphite or Midnight Ink — no chromatic body copy.
- Don't: use rectangular (non-pill) buttons.
- Don't: pair chromatic icon color with chromatic background — keep surface white and icon the only color.
- Don't: apply letter-spacing looser than -0.0050em.
- Don't: use the Parchment wash outside the hero — hero-only atmosphere.
- Gradient band: full-bleed atmospheric band transitioning dusty teal-green (~#5a7a72) left to warm amber-orange (~#c89148) right, no text/interactive overlay. Use once between major sections to break the parchment/white rhythm.

## Brand & Copy

Invent a fictional brand name, product, and all copy. Never use the real brand name "Flatfile", its logo, trademarks, or product names anywhere in the page. All user-facing copy must be in English. Use realistic, editorial-toned copy appropriate to a data-tooling product. No lorem-ipsum-only submissions; provide real labels and headings.

## Spacing & Layout Tokens

- Base unit: 8px. Density: comfortable.
- Spacing scale: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 64, 88, 112, 120px.
- Border radius: nav 99px, tags 8px, cards 12px, buttons 99px.
- Page max-width: 1200px. Section gap: 64–88px. Card padding: 24–32px. Element gap: 16px.

## Output

Produce `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js` only. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference. Enforce BEM naming consistently. Ensure full keyboard operability, ARIA labels, `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback, and `prefers-reduced-motion` respect. Persist theme choice via `localStorage`.
